purpose: Repair the combined-summary aggregation defect in the immutable EPSI v1 report without rerunning retrieval or altering any candidate set, per-question comparison, Gold match or cost row.

observedDefect.symptom: combined.summaries contains two rows with questions=0 and null recall even though the report contains 100 valid rows and combined.comparison contains 50 paired questions.
observedDefect.rootCause: The summarize function filtered row.datasetId === 'combined'; physical rows are labeled batchC or batchB, so the combined selection was empty.

fixedAlgorithm: Verify every frozen input hash before parsing the source report.
Require exactly 100 unique rows: 50 question IDs, exactly one L40_STRONG and one EPSI40 row per question, with datasetId batchC or batchB.
Recompute combined summaries by selecting all rows for each arm, not by requiring a physical combined dataset row.
Recompute Batch C and Batch B summaries and require byte-normalized semantic equality with their v1 summary values.
Recompute the combined per-question comparison from immutable row fields and require semantic equality with the v1 combined comparison.
Recompute the verdict from corrected combined summaries and the frozen combined comparison under the original v1 decision rules.
Hash every row candidateClaimIds/candidateSpanIds/candidateSourceIds tuple and prove it is copied unchanged; do not call retrieval or read Gold.

decisionRules.CORRECTED_FULL_PASS: Corrected v1 FULL_PASS conditions hold with valid combined summaries.
decisionRules.CORRECTED_SAFE_DISCOVERY_COST_UNPROVEN: At least one strict source win, zero source/evidence losses, union and budgets pass, token ceiling passes, but no non-latency cost advantage.
decisionRules.CORRECTED_SAFE_BUT_NO_DISCOVERY: Safety checks pass but there is no strict source win.
decisionRules.REWORK: Any frozen hash mismatch, row/candidate mutation, pairing error, dataset-summary drift, combined-comparison drift, overwrite, network/model/retrieval use or non-determinism.

prohibitions: Do not modify or overwrite the immutable EPSI v1 report or manifest.
Do not rerun retrieval, parse Gold, read Context Pack or Relation, or alter candidate rows.
Do not change budgets, eviction rules or decision thresholds.
Do not treat this post-hoc report repair as blind product evidence.
